Based on the provided data, there is no direct evidence of Li Hua sending a message to Jennifer expressing gratitude for the new training schedule before he requested a change in his training schedule. The closest instance is from entry 6 in the Sources section, where Li Hua informs Jennifer of a last-minute work meeting and suggests moving their training session to Friday:

```
6,"Time: 20260114_12:00
JenniferMoore: Hey Li Hua! Sorry for the last-minute change, but I have an unexpected work meeting tomorrow. Can we reschedule our training session to Friday instead? Let me know if that works for you. Thanks!
LiHua: Awesome! Friday works for me. How about the same time, 10:00 am? Looking forward to it! 😊
```

In this exchange, Li Hua does not thank Jennifer for the new training schedule; rather, he immediately proposes a new time for their session. There are no preceding messages from Li Hua in the given data that demonstrate appreciation for the schedule before the request to change it.
